[Date]

Appeals Department  
[Name of Medicaid health plan or denial issuer]  
[Appeals mailing address, fax number, or portal identified by the plan]

Re: Appeal of denial of prior authorization  
Member: Harper Novak  
Member ID: W970661607  
Requested service: Total hip replacement  
CPT code: 27130  
Reference number: POC-321500D934-38813  
Date of denial notice: July 31, 2026

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for total hip replacement, CPT 27130. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity.

The submitted records support medical necessity as follows:

- I have had nine months of progressive hip pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- I completed eight weeks of supervised physical therapy focused on hip-abductor strengthening and gait training, including 20 visits from April 9, 2026, through June 4, 2026. The physical therapy discharge note documents this treatment.
- I used NSAIDs for four months with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on April 12, 2026, provided only two weeks of partial relief.
- Weight-bearing AP pelvis radiographs obtained on June 13, 2026, show severe structural abnormalities, including superolateral joint-space narrowing to 1 mm, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophytes.
- My functional limitations are substantial: I require a cane, can walk only one block, and cannot put on my shoes without assistance.
- Examination documents positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.
- The record also documents the absence of active infection and untreated substance use. My BMI is 29, and I am a nonsmoker.

Together, these records document persistent and function-limiting symptoms, objective imaging abnormalities, failure of extensive conservative treatment, and examination findings consistent with the need for surgical treatment. Please review the complete prior-authorization packet, including the physical therapy discharge note, medication and injection history, June 13, 2026 radiology report, functional history, and orthopedic examination.

The publicly available materials I was able to review did not identify the specific Georgia Medicaid medical policy or clinical-review document applied to CPT 27130 in this case. The plan has not been quoted because that policy text was not provided or retrieved. Please identify the exact policy or clinical-review criteria used, including its title, policy number, version or effective date, and the specific documentation alleged to be missing. If additional information is required, please identify each item specifically and allow submission of the requested records during the appeal.

I request that the denial be overturned and that prior authorization for CPT 27130 be approved. If the denial is not overturned, please provide the complete clinical rationale, the exact criteria applied, the records reviewed, and instructions for any further appeal or fair-hearing rights.

The denial notice states that the appeal must be received by January 27, 2027. Please confirm receipt of this appeal and associate it with reference number POC-321500D934-38813.

Sincerely,

Harper Novak  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address]

Enclosures:

- Denial notice dated July 31, 2026
- Physical therapy discharge note documenting 20 visits from April 9, 2026, through June 4, 2026
- Medication history documenting four months of NSAID treatment
- Corticosteroid injection record dated April 12, 2026
- Weight-bearing AP pelvis radiograph report dated June 13, 2026
- Orthopedic examination and functional assessment
- Prior-authorization clinical summary
- Any additional records requested by the plan
